$comment: HighLevel API v2 requirements. Sources are official doc pages as quoted in web search results (the docs host marketplace.gohighlevel.com was blocked by this environment's network policy, so pages were not opened directly). Everything marked NEEDS CONFIRMATION must be checked on the live docs before implementation.

baseUrl.status: VERIFIED via official doc snippets in search results

Version.status: NEEDS CONFIRMATION — required on every call; most examples use 2021-07-28, while the custom-fields example shows 'v3'

auth.recommended: Private Integration Token (PIT) for the single Mansas Moguls sub-account (location)
auth.why: One business, one location, server-to-server. OAuth is for marketplace apps that serve many locations.

facts.fact: PITs are static and do not refresh automatically; rotation is done in Settings > Private Integrations
'Rotate and expire this token later' keeps the old token valid for 7 days
Token is shown once at creation
Token is bound to one sub-account

rateLimits.status: VERIFIED for OAuth public API 2.0; NEEDS CONFIRMATION that the same limits apply to PITs
rateLimits.onExceeded: HTTP 429; retry with exponential backoff and jitter; honour rate-limit response headers (names NEEDS CONFIRMATION)
rateLimits.expectedLoad: ≤ 5 calls per inquiry; far below limits

scopes.for: resolve custom field IDs by key
free slots (only if building custom booking)
create appointment (only if building custom booking)

endpoints.status: VERIFIED via official doc page as quoted in search results (page not opened directly)
endpoints.notes: Follows the location's 'Allow Duplicate Contact' setting; when two contacts match, updates the one matching the first field in the configured sequence. Body field names NEEDS CONFIRMATION.

endpoints.status: VERIFIED via official doc page as quoted in search results (page not opened directly)
VERIFIED via official doc page as quoted in search results (page not opened directly)
endpoints.notes: 2023-02-21 version documents a model filter (e.g. opportunity)
Not needed if workflows trigger on opportunity creation or tags.
Tags may also be sent in the upsert body (NEEDS CONFIRMATION).

webhooks.publicKey: NEEDS CONFIRMATION — copy from the current official guide; search copies were inconsistent
webhooks.availabilityForPrivateIntegrations: NEEDS CONFIRMATION (the guide is written for marketplace apps)

idempotency.approach: Client sends a UUID submissionId. The server finds an open opportunity for the contact in the Sales pipeline with that mm_submission_id or created in the last 10 minutes; if found, it appends a note instead of creating a new opportunity.
